note: Addendum to the immutable P0 snapshots. Per page: document directives that govern how its stylesheets decode or evaluate (meta charset, viewport, color-scheme; http-equiv pragmas and <base href> are rejected), every <link> in order with normalized attributes (any rel can become a stylesheet), executable scripts (resolved source, grammar, normalized activation attributes, inline import edges), handler import edges, and the runtime stylesheet sources the page can activate by reaching the installer through its static/literal-dynamic import graph. Page HTML is byte-identical to the base commit; Math Rain's pre-registry inline style sites were reachable only from math-rain.html. Not a claim that every reachable source is installed on every run.
